environment.description: AWS Lambda function with Function URL configured with AuthType=AWS_IAM. The resource-based policy on the Lambda function specifies a Condition block requiring aws:PrincipalOrgID matching the organization ID (o-a1b2c3d4e5) and the FunctionUrlAuthType is set to AWS_IAM in the function URL configuration. Callers without valid SigV4 signatures from principals within the organization receive HTTP 403 before the Lambda handler executes. The SQS event source mapping uses the internal service principal and messages originate only from the application's validated order service which sanitizes orderId to UUID format before enqueueing. Note: the SQL injection vulnerability remains in the code, but the only path to reach it with attacker-controlled input (the Function URL) requires IAM authentication from an org-internal principal.

config.sqs_message_origin: Internal order-service with UUID validation on orderId before SQS publish
config.vpc_config: Lambda in private subnet with RDS access
config.note: Unauthenticated HTTP requests to the Function URL receive 403 Forbidden at the Lambda service layer before handler invocation
